stories.title: Define Token Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the bearer token structure including token_id, subject, scopes, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revocation status. Establish serialization format, signing expectations, and validation rules aligned with existing auth.py behavior.

stories.title: Implement Core Token Lifecycle Logic
stories.description: Implement token issuance, rotation (versioning), expiration (TTL enforcement), and revocation checks. Ensure validation logic enforces all lifecycle states consistently based on patterns in auth.py.

stories.title: Token Validation Middleware and Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Implement request-level middleware to enforce bearer token validation and expose internal API endpoints for token validation, rotation trigger, and revocation. Validate signature, expiration, scope, and revocation status with consistent 401/403 responses.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Edge Case and Security Test Coverage
stories.description: Develop focused tests for edge cases including expired tokens, invalid signatures, replay attempts, rotated tokens with stale versions, and revoked tokens. Validate failure modes and enforcement behavior.

stories.title: Integrate Token Lifecycle with GPTReader and Azure Functions
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle validation into GPTReader and Azure Functions entry points. Ensure all inbound requests require valid bearer tokens and lifecycle enforcement is consistently applied across data access and pipeline operations.
